fields.source: Citizens of Skyrim, they are a tall and fair-haired people.  Strong and hardy, Nords are famous for their resistance to cold and their talent as warriors. They can use a Battlecry to make opponents flee.
fields.target: 作為天霜的驃悍種族，他們身材魁梧，一頭金髮。他們的特質是身強力壯，精通各種戰士技巧，而諾德人對寒冷的抵抗力更是名聞遐邇。他們還能夠發出戰嚎使敵人驚慌逃跑。

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Augh Aah! Wrong target dragonborn, wrong target!

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: 不！這個紀錄不應該就這樣結束的！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Argh! Well now, this isn't looking good...

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: 啊、噢！發生失誤！發生失誤！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: 噢，給我準備好！這不會是我的結局！…喔等等…該死！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh! Hey now! Would it be too late for a compromise?
fields.target: 啊！嘿！現在拆夥會不會太慢了？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 沉重呼吸 * 我還沒完，你這混帳！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ha! Just try to hit me!
fields.target: 哈！來打我啊！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Maybe you want to hit less like a pathetic wimp!

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hu-Aah!
fields.target: 呼 - 啊！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ha, that's it!?
fields.target: 哈，就這樣！？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: 雖然我很享受幹架，但我真的得做建檔的工作。所以可以請你倒下然後就這樣掛掉嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ha ha ha! You're so pathetic! You actually think you can win?!
fields.target: 哈、哈、哈！你真可悲！你真的以為你可以贏？！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Yeah, sorry but you're not worth it to put in my records so, goodbye!
fields.target: 耶，雖然很抱歉，但你沒被我記錄的價值，所以，再見吧！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I needed a water bath, but I guess you're blood will do, hahaha!
fields.target: 我剛好想洗個澡，剛好你的血可以用，哈哈哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Let's play a game! It's called, "Who's still standing?" Don't worry, there's a very clear winner, and it's about to be me!
fields.target: 來玩個遊戲！就叫『誰會站到最後？』別擔心，這邊很個很明顯的贏家，就是我！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *heavy breathing* Stay...Still! Seriously, this whole fiasco would be so much easier if you would stop squirming!
fields.target: * 呼吸沉重 * 還…站著！說真的，如果你別那麼害怕，那你會死的更痛快一點！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: How does a blade to your heart sound? Or, maybe your neck? I'm feeling... generous *giggles*
fields.target: 刀刺穿你的心臟的聲音如何？還是，你的脖子？我…很夠意思吧。 * 咯咯笑 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Yes, please! Do keep screaming in pain. That makes the fight that much more...fun ha ha ha!
fields.target: 對，拜託！繼續叫吧。這會讓戰鬥更加…有趣！哈、哈、哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You ever heard of "the bandit who challenged the dragonborn"? That's cause not one of you lived to tell it!
fields.target: 你有聽過「能挑戰龍裔的強盜」嗎？因為你們沒有一個能活著亂講話！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey, if it makes you feel better, you died a bandit...Pfff! Hahahaha!! Okay, nevermind, this is just a lose-lose for you.
fields.target: 嘿，如果這可以讓你好過一點，你這該死的強盜…呸！哈哈哈哈！Okay，別在意，因為你只會輸·輸·輸。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, another boring bandit? Honestly, you guys reproduce like bunnies or something.
fields.target: 啊，又一個找死的強盜？老實說，連兔子都比你們還厲害。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey, do us all a favor and die. Maybe then the empire can weed out the weak ones like you.
fields.target: 嘿，拜託幫個忙掛掉吧。這樣帝國才可以淘汰掉你這種遜咖。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And the empire wonders how the Thalmor won against a legion of weaklings like you.
fields.target: 而帝國很好奇梭默怎麼會贏得了你們這種遜咖軍團。

fields.source: Welp, I hope you don't miss the Imperial City because you're never going to back there. Alive, at least.
fields.target: 好吧，我希望你不會太想念帝國城市，因為你永遠都回不到那邊啦！至少，活著的時候。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Wow, I guess all those farmers did get drafted as stormcloaks. Ulfric must be desperate.
fields.target: 哇嗚，連這些農民都會被風暴斗篷徵召。烏弗瑞克肯定非常危急。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, on the bright side, if Ulfric were to fail his rebellion, you won't live to see it.
fields.target: 唉，往好的方向看，就算烏弗瑞克造反失敗，你也不會活著看到。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Before fighting for independence, why don't you learn how to fight?
fields.target: 在為獨立奮戰之前，你怎麼不先練練功夫？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hope there aren't any imperials in Sovenguarde, because that'll be your new home very soon.
fields.target: 希望沉睡淨土裡面沒有帝國人，因為那邊很快就會變成你家了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: No one even likes you. And I mean no one, I surveyed!
fields.target: 沒人會喜歡你。對，就是沒個鬼影都妹有，我都查過了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Thalmor? Ugh, I so would love a thal-less world. And yes, that one's for you.
fields.target: 梭默？啊，我好想要一個少「梭」的世界啊。而且對，少掉得那一個就是你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Are you actually this much of an asshole or are you not aware of your insane levels of douchebaggery?
fields.target: 你是天生就這麼王八蛋，還是根本沒發現你早就起肖到破錶了？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know what I wish for? Thalmor genocide. But I guess I'll start with you.
fields.target: 你知道我最希望啥嗎？讓梭默絕種。但我想可以先從你身上開刀。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We're sorry for disturbing your slumber, we'll remedy that very soon.
fields.target: 很抱歉打擾你們睡覺，我們會很快就再讓你們睡下去。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: 這是我的一個新新聞：璐音殺了死人。超合理的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Don't worry, this time, I'll make sure you don't ever wake from the dead again.
fields.target: 別擔心，這一次，我保證你們會永遠睡下去。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: Daanik ah draugr！Yeah！Kilaan us dilon right back at ya！（天生就是屍鬼獵人！耶！你們馬上要翹辮子啦！）
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Spiders, spiders! Why did it have to be spiders!
fields.target: 蜘蛛、蜘蛛！天殺的為什麼是蜘蛛！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Seeing you guys, it's very clear why there's such a thing as arachnophobia.
fields.target: 看看你們這些傢夥，非常明顯為什麼會有蜘蛛恐懼症這玩意。

fields.target: 咿，噫！快樂的地方，璐音，快樂的地方！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You guys scare me no less than the ones spawned by nature.
fields.target: 你們這些傢夥跟那些從大自然裡冒出來的一樣齁我驚驚。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I can't believe the dwemer were okay with you freaks crawling about. Well I'm not!
fields.target: 我不相信鍛莫會覺得讓你們這些怪胎爬來爬去是 OK 的。至少我受不了！

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Uhm, hehe, nice... large, killing, machine, or doom, hehe...
fields.target: 呃、嘻嘻、很好…龐大、殺掉、機械，還是毀滅，嘻嘻…

fields.source: Maybe, just maybe, it'll accept a peace offering of oil. Nope! It just made it more mad. Aaah!
fields.target: 或許、只是或許，給它油的話就會停下來了。哇靠！反而讓它更起肖啦。啊啊啊！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ha! You think I'm scared of your, giant stature and deadly steam?! Then, you guessed right!

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I better get more than just your toe after this!
fields.target: 我賭這之後，我可以拿到比你腳趾更多的東西！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Sorry mammoths, but you'll have to find a new master soon. You're old one's retiring very soon.

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Please don't send me flying, please don't send me flying, please don't send me flying!
fields.target: 別讓我飛、拜託別讓我飛、千萬別讓我飛起來啊！

fields.source: You will die by the dovahkiin's hand today, dragon!
fields.target: 你今天會死在都瓦克因的手下，龍！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: This will definitely be an epic fight for the records! Or an epic loot record, we'll see.
fields.target: 這肯定會成為紀錄上傳奇的一頁！或者不斷重複的傳奇紀錄，我們等著瞧。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Alduin krov mol Skizaan, dov! Iraak pas reivik!
fields.target: Alduin krov mol Skizaan，dov！Iraak pas reivik！（奧杜因早晚會完蛋，巨龍！和平會到來的！）
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Dir los threnahk! Dovahkiin us Ferahnok!
fields.target: Dir los threnahk！Dovahkiin us Ferahnok！（嗝屁吧！龍裔贏定了！）
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 3P04- no, no, no, no! Not now! Come on, it's a dragon, for dovahkiin's sake!
fields.target: 紀錄 3P04- 不、不、不、不！不是現在！看在都瓦克因的份上，拜託，那是條龍！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: If I cut your tail, do you grow a new one? I'll test it with you. For science!
fields.target: 如果我割了你的尾巴，你會再長新的嗎？為了科學，我們來實驗一下！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You're ancestors must've been high on skooma to mate with a reptile.
fields.target: 你們祖先肯定嗑藥嗑到太 High 才會跑去跟蜥蜴約會。

fields.source: You should've stayed in the water. At least there, only the fishies can hurt you.
fields.target: 你真應該待在水底。好歹那裡，只有小魚兒會咬你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: What's the matter? Cat got your tongue? Hahaha!
fields.target: 怎麼啦？貓抓了你的舌頭？哈哈哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Cats have nine lives right? You won't even have one left when I'm through.
fields.target: 貓有九條命，對吧？給我處理後你們就一條命都不剩啦。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, do you at least groom yourselves like proper cats? Well, guess it won't matter once you're dead.
fields.target: 呃，好歹你們也把自己打扮成貓該有的樣子吧？算了，反正對掛掉的你們來說也沒差。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm going to name your corpse Mr. Fluffles! It's a lot more fitting than whatever you have now, I'm sure.
fields.target: 我要把你命名為「屍體·絨毛先生」！我肯定，這更適合現在的你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, you guys sure aren't spooky or scary to me.
fields.target: 嗯，你們這些傢夥肯定不會讓我起雞皮疙瘩，還是嚇到我。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, fighting you won't even be fun. You're just all bones, there's no flesh tearing or guts spilling.
fields.target: 呃，跟你們打架一點都不好玩。你們全是骨頭，砍下去一點手感都妹有。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm pretty sure me killing you will hurt more than sticks or stones!
fields.target: 我很肯定殺你的方式，會比用木棍還是石頭要更痛！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I need some butter, some salt, and oh yeah, your meat!
fields.target: 我需要點奶油、鹽，還有…喔、耶，你的肉！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Please don't pinch me, please don't pinch me!
fields.target: 拜託別夾到我，拜託別夾到我！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oo! I always loved puppies! Or, overgrown wolves, same thing. Both fluffy!
fields.target: 喔！我一直都喜歡小狗！不然，發育過度的狼也可以。都那麼軟綿綿的！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh no, I suck at wolf speak. Woof! Woof! Howl!
fields.target: 喔、不，我超愛狼的叫聲。汪！汪！敖嗚！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I count... ONE! Dead vampire! Muahaha!
fields.target: 又來…一個！死吸血鬼！姆哈哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Don't worry, at least your ashes will be serving a better purpose once your dead!
fields.target: 別擔心，至少死後你的灰燼會拿來做更好的用途！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Where's the seduction and guile? Better yet, have you even looked in a mirror before?
fields.target: 魅力和迷惑跑哪裡去了？你之前，有沒有好好照過鏡子？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I count...ONE! Dead vampire! Muahaha!
fields.target: 我數到…一個！死吸血鬼！姆哈哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Why are you haunting me? How are you even bleeding? AAAHH! Please just die please just die!
fields.target: 你想狩獵我嗎？為什麼你還會流血？啊啊啊！拜託你快給我死一死吧！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Die!! A...again? Ugh, now I'm getting a headache, just... BEGONE!
fields.target: 死吧！！再…死一次？啊，我要開始頭痛了，反正快點給我…消失！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Great, another bear? Hey Dragonborn! Can you "bear"ly?!
fields.target: 太棒了，又一隻熊？嘿，龍裔！你還真是「熊熊」好？！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Begone! You're becoming *giggles* un"bear"able! Hahahaha!
fields.target: 去死吧！這樣你就可以去演 * 咯咯笑 * 功夫「熊」貓啦！哈哈哈哈！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: With all the bear puns in my head, I think I'll slay me before you do!
fields.target: 當所有的熊都擠到我頭上來時，我想我會在你們大快朵頤之前就先自殺！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Don't worry, at least your ashes will be serving a better purpose once your dead!
fields.target: 別擔心，至少死後你的灰燼會拿來做更好的用途！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 5D66: Dragonborn has spotted the enemy, and has started sprinting towards... hey, hey wait for me!
fields.target: 紀錄 5D66：龍裔瞄準了敵人，然後全力衝刺…嘿、嘿、等等我呀！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: This'll be interesting...
fields.target: 這會很有趣…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I guess I can include a few more for the annihilation records.
fields.target: 我想我可以多紀錄幾條徹底殲滅的訊息。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Protocol to eradicate enemy engaged. Let the killing commence!
fields.target: 殲滅敵人的協定。動手開殺吧！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Now here's the action I've always wanted. Don't disappoint!
fields.target: 現在有場我一直希望的行動。別讓我失望！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Alright! Time for some action!
fields.target: 好！是時候該採取些行動了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *sigh* would there ever be a day where we'll talk before fight? Nope, don't think so, but I don't mind!
fields.target: * 嘆氣 * 下次見面我們可以先聊天後再幹架嗎？不，我想沒法度，但我也不介意！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Mmm, maybe I should've invested in a larger bag. Hard to fight with all these files!
fields.target: 嗯，也許我該買個大一點的袋子。帶著這些檔案真的很難幹架！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You won't stop the dragonborn! Not while I breathe!
fields.target: 你沒辦法阻止龍裔！只要我還活著就不行！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You realize you just make the dragonborn's adventure longer and thus, my records bigger!? You'll pay for that extra weight I have to carry!
fields.target: 你知道你這樣做只是讓龍裔的冒險更長更麻煩，還讓我的紀錄更多更龐大嗎！？你得為我那些新增加的檔案重量付出代價！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, another boring bandit? Honestly, you guys reproduce like bunnies or something.
fields.target: 啊，又一個找死的強盜？老實說，連兔子都比你們還厲害。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Welp, I hope you don't miss the imperial city because you're never going back there. Alive, at least.
fields.target: 那，我希望你不會想念帝國城市，因為你回不去啦。至少，活著的時候。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Before fighting for independence, why don't you learn how to fight?
fields.target: 在為獨立奮戰之前，你怎麼不先練練功夫？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know what I wish for? Thalmor genocide. But I guess I'll start with you.
fields.target: 你知道我最希望啥嗎？讓梭默絕種。但我想可以先從你身上開刀。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Daanik ah draugr! Yeah! Kilaan us dilon right back at ya!
fields.target: Daanik ah draugr！Yeah！Kilaan us dilon right back at ya！（天生就是屍鬼獵人！耶！你們馬上要翹辮子啦！）
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Spiders, spiders! Why did it have to be spiders!?
fields.target: 蜘蛛、蜘蛛！為什麼一定得是蜘蛛！？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Really? First fleshy spiders, now mechanical ones? This journey really is testing my limits.
fields.target: 真的假的？先是肥胖的蜘蛛，現在還來搞機械化？這趟旅程真是屢屢挑戰我的極限。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Uhm, hehe, nice... large, killing, machine, or doom, hehe...
fields.target: 呃、嘻嘻、很好…龐大、殺掉、機械，還是毀滅，嘻嘻…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ha! You think I'm scared of your, giant stature and deadly steam?! Then, you guessed right!
fields.target: 哈！你以為我會怕你們龐大的身軀和要命的蒸氣？！媽啦，你猜對了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Please don't send me flying, please don't send me flying, please don't send me flying!
fields.target: 別讓我飛、拜託別讓我飛、千萬別讓我飛起來啊！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You will die by the dovahkiin's hand today, dragon!
fields.target: 你今天會死在都瓦克因的手下，龍！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You should've stayed in the water. At least there, only the fishies can hurt you.
fields.target: 你真應該待在水底。好歹那裡，只有小魚兒會咬你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm going to name your corpse Mr. Fluffles! It's a lot more fitting than whatever you have now, I'm sure.
fields.target: 我要把你命名為「屍體·絨毛先生」！我肯定，這更適合現在的你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, you guys sure aren't spooky or scary to me.
fields.target: 嗯，你們這些傢夥肯定不會讓我起雞皮疙瘩，還是嚇到我。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, I prefer sushi, but I guess some delicious crab will do for tonight!
fields.target: 嗯，雖然我更喜歡吃壽司，但我想今晚來點美味的蟹肉也不錯！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *heavy breathing* Record 5D..20...Oh, forget it. I need a moment here.
fields.target: * 呼吸沉重 * 紀錄 5D… 20… 喔，算了。我需要點時間休息。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: All right! That was a good warm up.
fields.target: 很好！這是很好的暖身運動。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I don't kill because I like to. I kill because I love to mhmhmhm!
fields.target: 我殺人不是因為我喜歡，我殺人是因為我超愛 ~~ 姆哼哼哼！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *heavy breathing* Woooh! I really should lay off on those sweetrolls...
fields.target: * 呼吸沉重 * 嗚喔！我真應該躺在一堆甜塔上頭…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Victory to team Dragonborn, again! Hm, I should just delete the "dragonborn loses" category.
fields.target: 再一次，團隊勝利，龍裔！嗯，我應該來把《龍裔慘敗》這分類砍掉。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh..was...was that it? O-okay then onwards! I guess!
fields.target: 喔…就…就這樣？好 - 好，那就走吧！我猜啦！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Reqeuiesca-a I -I mean...ehm... bye!
fields.target: 哩扣吚嘻啊 - 啊 - 我是說…嗯…掰掰！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Rest in pieces, it'll be easier for the skeevers to clean up your mess.
fields.target: 斷成碎片，這樣惡鼠才比較好清掉你們這些雜碎。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Huh, and I thought talking balls of light and floating white bears were the weirdest things I've seen...
fields.target: 呃，我還以為和發光的球和跟漂浮的白熊說話，已經是我看過最奇怪的事情了…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Shouts, you shall receive. Very wise, be these priests.
fields.target: 吼聲，你會得到的。當這些修道士，非常聰明。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: One can say say: things sure are getting hairy up in here. Oh don't look so unamused, you know it's true!
fields.target: 有人會這樣說：「這邊的毛會越來越多。」喔，別一副不可置信的表情，你明明知道那是真的！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Y-you did it! He's finally dead! Yes! Dragonborn: 1, Alduin: negative infinity, because you're never coming back!
fields.target: 你 ~ 你辦到了！牠終於掛了！太好了！龍裔：1，奧杜因：負的無限大，因為你永遠回不來啦！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Looks like Alduin... has fallen from grace.
fields.target: 看起來奧杜因…已經失去恩賜了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And Dragonborn has met the figurative "old man in the cave". Well, in this case, an old fort. And "old MEN" giving shouts, not swords.
fields.target: 龍裔遇到了傳說中的「洞穴中的老人」。 嗯，就這一次來說，是古老要塞。而「老人」給的是吼聲，不是刀劍。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Durarara! Dragonborn received a shout! Yay! Hehe, Okay, I'll just go stand over there...
fields.target: 嘟啦啦啦！龍裔學到了一個吼聲！耶！嘻嘻，好啦，我會到旁邊乖乖站好…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Bartender! Hi, yes would you have any bottled water by any chance? Oh, and ten sweetrolls with that please!
fields.target: 酒保！嗨，對、不管怎樣你有任何一瓶水嗎？喔，拜託順便和十個甜塔一起來！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Warm bed, fire, shelter... the rowdy patrons aren't exactly upping the appeal factor, but, eh, I'll live
fields.target: 溫暖的床、火、庇護所…雖然那些過 High 的奧客很討人厭，不過、呃，我還是會住。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: So we paid around 5 gold for the ale, and 10 gold for some sweetrolls... How much do we have to tip, do you know?
fields.target: 所以我們花了 5 金幣買麥酒， 10 金幣買甜塔…你知道，我們該給多少小費嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Did I ever tell you how I owned an inn? It wasn't exactly "in"tact for very long though hehehehe!... Okay, you have my permission to slap me.
fields.target: 我有告訴過你，我是怎麼有間自己的旅店嗎？雖然它並沒有「完」好無缺很久過，嘻嘻嘻嘻！…好，我允許你來賞我一巴掌。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Finally! A warm fire! Oh, this is absolutely blissful! And no, before you say dragon fire's the same thing, its not!
fields.target: 終於！溫暖的火！喔，這真是太幸福了！還有並沒有，在你說巨龍噴火也一樣溫暖之前，我跟你說不是！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Shocking there's no milk option in the menu. What were all those cows for then, huh? Tipping?
fields.target: 真驚訝這裡的菜單竟然沒有牛奶。那養那些牛是幹嘛的，嗯？搞笑嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: They say brawl fights at an inn only create chaos and disturbance for the place. I say it builds character! Plus, everyone's always applauding you.
fields.target: 他們說在旅店裡爭吵打架只會給這地方帶來混亂和騷動。我說這才叫有個性！而且，每個人都會為你鼓掌叫好。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Look, if we get caught, we cannot let them have our files. So, you should probably take all of them.
fields.target: 仔細聽，如果被抓到，絕不能讓他們保有我們的檔案資料。所以，你應該把他們全搞定。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Please don't look this way, please don't look this way!
fields.target: 拜託別往這邊看，拜託別往這邊看！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: All this sneaking business is going to give me a heart attack from the anticipation and anxiety! ... What do you mean I'm being over dramatic?
fields.target: 對這些潛行工作的期待跟渴望總是讓我的心臟幾乎快跳出來！ …你說我太誇張是啥意思？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: As long as we keep our footsteps light, I don't think we'll get caught. Ugghh, I shouldn't have eaten all those sweetrolls.
fields.target: 只要我們繼續輕輕的挪動腳步，我不認為我們會被抓。呃~，我真不應該把吃那麼多甜塔。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Shh, I heard strange noises nearby! It was... Oh, wait, false alarm, that was my stomach.
fields.target: 噓，我聽到這附近有怪怪的聲音！這是…喔，等等，拍謝我搞錯了，那是我的肚子。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: !!  Shoot! Sorry, the recorder's acting up again, stupid thing.
fields.target: ！！該死！抱歉，紀錄器又可以運作了，笨東西。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And here we stand at yet another cave! Reflecting on previous records, we're going to enter this dangerous, dark, and suicidal cave, I assume?
fields.target: 我們又站在另一個洞穴上頭！目前的紀錄清楚表示，我們得到這個危險、黑暗、進去就等於自殺的洞穴，是吧？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oo, a cave! Thoughts, Record? Well Dragonborn, I'm sure there's lots of things in there that just want to tear our hearts out. But, you're the boss.
fields.target: 噢，又是洞穴！璐音，想清楚點？好吧龍裔，我很肯定那裡頭有一堆東西想把我們的心挖出來撕成碎片。但，你是老大你說了算。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Echo! Record and Dragonborn here! Hehehe... Oh, I just realized that was probably a horrible idea...
fields.target: 迴音！璐音和龍裔在這裡！嘻嘻嘻…喔，我說完才發現這點子爛透了…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Maybe at the end of this cave we'll find a majestic unicorn. But then knowing our luck, it'll probably just be a rampaging killer stampeding monster.
fields.target: 或許在這洞穴的盡頭，我們可以找到雄偉的獨角獸。但以我們目前的運氣，牠大概是隻會到處找碴的殺人猛獸。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Analysis of current situation: we're in a place filled with dead people and gross tombs. Conclusion: WHY ARE WE HERE!?
fields.target: 分析正確的情況：我們在充滿死人和噁爛的墳墓裡頭。結論：我們為啥來這裡！？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Question, is all this tomb raiding an instinctual thing? Or a childhood hobby? Just trying to understand the fun in being around angry dead people.
fields.target: 問題，掃蕩這些墳墓是出自於本能？還是童年嗜好？請試著瞭解要如何在一堆抓狂的死人身邊獲得歡樂。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, the rot and smell from these draugrs are nearly unbearable. Ah, but there is one redeeming quality about them though! Those shiny blue eyes~
fields.target: 噁，這些屍鬼身上腐爛的味道真是讓人受不了。啊，不過他們身上還是有個東西可以彌補！ 閃閃發光的藍眼睛 ~
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey, pop quiz! Guess what we'll find in this draugr crypt filled with undead people? Did you guess draugr? 'Cause wrong, I was thinking linen wraps!
fields.target: 嘿，急智問答！猜猜我們在這到處都是死人的屍鬼地窖裡可以找到什麼？你猜是屍鬼？錯，答案是一堆亞麻布捲！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Careful for those pipes! The gases stuck in there are probably millennia old. You don't want that all up in your nose, I'm sure.
fields.target: 小心那些管道！那些氣體可能已經卡在裡頭上千年了。我很肯定，你不會希望那些全都灌到你鼻子裡。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Maybe there're some spare parts around here I can use to fix my recorder. It'll be: Recorder Version 4.0 Dwemer Edition!
fields.target: 也許這裡有些剩下的東西，可以讓我拿來修理紀錄器。那就會變成：紀錄者 Version 4.0 鍛莫版本！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ughh, really? They just had to make mechanized spiders? Why not mechanical dogs, or bunnies?
fields.target: 呃，真的假的？他們就只作了機械蜘蛛？為什不做些機械狗、機械兔？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 6E21: Currently we are inside a fort filled with bandits or something else much more scarier that wants to kill us. Impending doom: 100%
fields.target: 紀錄 6E21：很顯然我們到了一個充滿強盜，還是有其他更恐怖、想殺死我們的玩意的堡壘裡頭。大難臨頭：100 %。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Let's be positive, Recorder! We may be in a hive of deadly enemies, endless staircases,  and possible creepy dungeons below.
fields.target: 看開一點，璐音姬！ 就算我們可能是在一個充滿要命敵人、走不完的樓梯、還令人渾身發寒的地牢底下。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well on the bright side, at least this place has more structure than caves! On the dark side, it's still filled with a lot of things that want to kil
fields.target: 嗯，就好的方面來說，至少這邊比洞穴像樣點！以壞的方面看，它裡面還是塞滿一堆想砍人的鬼玩意。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm impressed that they can live out in a tent for days on end. I, on the other hand, need a warm bed, clean water, and oh, a proper shelter!
fields.target: 我對他們可以日以繼夜的待在外面的帳篷感到不可思議。我，沒法度，偶要暖暖的床、純純的水，還有舒舒服服的房間！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: This is not a good idea, this is not a good idea! Well, unless you wanna see some dragons, this is not a good idea!
fields.target: 這不是好主意、這不是好主意！呃，除非你想多看幾條龍，這不是個好點子！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: If by any chance we hear really, really loud flapping noises, or a loud roar, run!
fields.target: 不論如何，如果我們聽到真的、真的很大聲的翅膀揮舞、還是咆哮的聲音，趕快跑！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Good morning! Good day! Salutations!... Okay, just trying to be polite here, jeezus.
fields.target: 早安！日安！大家好！…好，試著在這裡有禮貌一點，天啊。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Where does the trash of Skyrim go? Better yet, where are the baths?!
fields.target: 天霜的垃圾都會送到哪去？還有更重要是，哪裡可以洗澡？！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Alchemists eat all of their ingredients right?  I'm not sure if I admire their ability or am utterly disgusted.
fields.target: 煉金術師會吃掉牠們所有的原料對吧？我不確定我會為他們吃掉那些噁爛東西的技能表示欽佩。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey, do you think I have a fever? I'm starting to feel woozy and dizzy... Or was it those 50 sweetrolls I had...
fields.target: 嘿，你看我發燒了嗎？我開始有點頭昏腦脹…難不成是因為我肚子裡的 50 個甜塔…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I don't think we've seen one decent cat in our travels! Okay Khajits and sabre monsters don't count!
fields.target: 為什麼我們在旅途中都沒看過可愛的貓！不，凱季特貓人和劍齒虎不能算！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Enemy recap: Guards, thalmor, dragons, chickens... now chickens, that's...that's something to fear.
fields.target: 敵人摘要：守衛、梭默、龍、雞…現在還有雞，那…還是令讓人害怕的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: There's gotta be requirement for alchemists to burn their tongues off or something. I mean, no one with sanity can seriously snort vampire dust.
fields.target: 煉金術士肯定是在某個地方把他們的舌頭都給燒掉了。我說，根本沒有一個有理智的人會跑去猛吸「吸血鬼灰燼」。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Finally, somewhere not dark, where we won't be attacked by monsters or bandits, and a great source for sweetrolls!
fields.target: 終於啊，一個沒有黑暗、沒有會找碴的怪物和強盜的地方，還有這麼多好好吃的甜塔！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: All your holds belong to us! Muahhahah... Okay, just to the dragonborn... and as a thane, but someday!
fields.target: 你的都是我們的！姆哈哈哈哈…好啦，都是身為男爵…的龍裔的，但總有一天！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Sorry, trying not to trip over all the lizard and cat tails everywhere. Contain your tails, people!
fields.target: 拍謝，正試著不要被滿地的蜥蜴和貓尾巴給絆倒。管好你的尾巴，兄弟！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Wait! I smell *sniff sniff* sweetrolls! Yaaaay!!
fields.target: 等等！我聞到了 * 嗅 * * 嗅 * 甜塔！耶！！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Give me a D! Give me an R! Give me a Aaagonborn, go dragonborn! What? You've never heard that cheer before?
fields.target: 給我個ㄌ！給我個ㄨ！給我個ㄥˊ一ˋ，上吧龍裔！瞎密？你以前沒聽過啦啦隊這樣炒氣氛的嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Living near a grave? And a huge one at that! Do these people enjoy living in disturbing conditions or something?
fields.target: 住在墓園旁？還是個大墳場！這些人很享受住在讓人不安的狀態還是怎樣？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I don't know who's worse in this city: the people who outright try to stab your back or the ones who say they're friends, then stab your back.
fields.target: 我不知道還有哪裡能比這城市還糟：人們會光明正大的直接從背後捅你一刀；還有人會說他們是朋友，結果還是照捅不誤。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And here we are in the capital city of Skyrim. Funny that it's all the way at the borders of the land, clearly genius tactical positioning.
fields.target: 我們到了天霜的首都。有趣的是，它是這土地所有道路的邊界，完美的戰略地位。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Now welcome to Solitude! The center of trade and modernity. On your right as you enter, you'll see our prized asset: the chopping block!
fields.target: 歡迎來到獨孤城！往你的右手邊看，那是我們最珍貴的資產：斷頭臺！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hand me a bow. Or a crossbow. Anything, as long as we can shoot down that damn eagle before it poops on everything!
fields.target: 給我把弓、十字弓也行、什麼都好，只要是能把那些愛到處拉屎的死老鷹射下來的玩意都可以！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know what these people need? Someone to take out the stick from up their asses. They're all so stuck up, its making me gag.
fields.target: 你知道這些人需要什麼嗎？真有人該幫他們把那塞在屁股裡面的木棍拿出來。他們走路超卡，讓我很想笑。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Don't play tag with the kids! It's a trap to a never ending chase around the city.
fields.target: 別跟小鬼玩捉迷藏！那會讓你在城市裡跑個沒完。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: With all respect to the lovely Jarl Elisif, I don't think she can decide what wear or when to shit without General Tulius' or her steward's input.
fields.target: 獻上對美麗的艾莉希芙領主全部敬意：如果沒了圖留斯將軍還是她的總管，我看她連怎麼穿衣服和上廁所都不知道。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: For a place called the Blue Palace, I'm seeing an awful lot of red around here.
fields.target: 就以一個叫做藍宮的地方來說，我看到了一堆爛透了的紅色遍佈四周。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: If we see Braith, she better be ready for a falcon punch from me! Annoying little brat.
fields.target: 如果我們看到布賴斯，她最好做好被我扁的心理準備！欠揍的小鬼。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Thank god Belethor doesn't have a sister. If she's his relative, I'm not sure anyone would want to buy her.
fields.target: 感謝老天貝萊託爾沒有妹妹。如果她是他的家人，我不確定會不會有人想跟她買東西。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: That preacher needs a little less Talos in his life and bit more shutting up. Does he ever take a break?
fields.target: 那個傳道士的生命裡需要少點塔洛斯，然後給我惦惦。他都不用休息的喔？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I don't know how I feel about being in a city, as a foreigner, that hates anyone else but their own kind. If I get jumped, I'm out.
fields.target: 作為一個外來者，我不知道我對這座城市的感覺是什麼，他們痛恨除了自己種族以外的所有人。如果我被盯上，就得滾出去。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Great, another city, covered in snow. And it's made purely of stone. Why not just call this place my living oblivion.
fields.target: 太棒了，另一座城市，被雪覆蓋。純粹以石頭打造。為什麼不叫這個地方做「我栩栩如生的湮滅領域」。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I feel something... oh wait. It's just my soul turning into ice.
fields.target: 我感覺到…喔、等等。這幾乎把我的靈魂也凍成冰了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Can't imagine there used to be a whole thriving city here. Now it's just a dead ghost town.
fields.target: 無法想像那裡曾有過一座繁華無比的城市。現在它不過是座鬼城罷了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh look! A human! Okay, I know it's a city, but in this environment, I feel its rarer to spot a human than an ice wraith!
fields.target: 喔、看看！有人耶！好，我知道這裡是城市，但看看這環境，我覺得要看到人比遇上冰幻靈還困難！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Who'd want to get married in Riften? It would be a miracle if the groom can make it to the altar without having the ring or his wife stolen.
fields.target: 誰會想在裂谷城結婚？在這裡新郎如果可以保住自己或是他老婆的戒指就是奇蹟了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: H--Huh? Hey Dragonborn, have you seen my sweetroll?... Goddamn thieves! I got my sweetroll stolen!
fields.target: 哈 -- 蛤？嘿，龍裔，你有看到我的甜塔嗎？該死的小偷！我的甜塔被偷了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Maybe Maven will take my pitch about selling pure, refreshing bottled water. I mean, she'd be monopolizing on something vital to living.
fields.target: 那個瑪雯可能會想用我那販賣純淨、恢復疲勞能量水的點子。因為，她是活著的目的就是為了壟斷熱門商品。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, I must be thieves guild's most favorite target for sweetrolls. They're always gone, it's infuriating. And quite honestly, really sad.
fields.target: 呃，我一定是盜賊公會最喜歡下手偷甜塔的目標。他們老是一溜煙就不見了，超讓人抓狂。而且說真的，超讓人不爽。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *gasp* I just remembered where I put my file now! It was- Oh, I don't think I can get it back...
fields.target: * 喘氣 * 我才剛想起來我把檔案放到哪！它在 ~ 噢，我想我沒辦法拿回來了…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *Sneezes* Ugh... why does it always have to be holds with snow in them *sneezes*
fields.target: * 打噴嚏 * 呃…為什麼一定得在雪裡拿著它們。 * 打噴嚏 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *Yawns*
fields.target: * 打哈欠 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: So thankful there are horses and carriages in Skyrim. I know the pain of having your two legs be the ONLY form of traveling through barren wasteland.
fields.target: 謝天謝地天霜還有馬和馬車。我深深瞭解「只」用自己兩條腿翻山越嶺的痛苦。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: The lovely sun, the beautiful blue skies... How long will we have this peace for I wonder...
fields.target: 可愛的太陽，美麗的藍天…還要多久我們才可以享受我那夢寐以求的平靜…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: What was that last quest we just finished? I can't recall what it was we had to go get... Or was it kill?
fields.target: 我們上次完成的任務是什麼？我想不起來我們是去拿…還是殺什麼？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *hums a strange tune*
fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Dragonborn, dragonborn, does whatever a dragon can...well, I don't think flying...
fields.target: 龍裔 ~ 龍裔 ~ 龍裔到底可以做什麼呢…嗯，我想他飛不起來…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *hums a strange tune*
fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 哼奇怪的旋律 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Did you ever wonder if there's a dovadeer? Or a dovacow? Who says dragon blood must be limited to people?
fields.target: 你難道都不好奇有沒有 龍裔鹿？還是 龍裔牛嗎？誰說龍之血只會出現在人身上？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I know, I get a little "crazy" when we fight. But hey, its good exercise and action! Might, as well enjoy it no?
fields.target: 我暸，我戰鬥的時候有點「肖肖」。但、嘿，那是很好的練習啊！難道，不能好好享受嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *stretching sounds*
fields.target: * 伸展的聲音 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *stretching sounds*
fields.target: * 伸展的聲音 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know what would be nice? Fences. One too many times I went the wrong way. I mean, it has a similar look to the road! How was I supposed to know..
fields.target: 你知道什麼會很好嗎？圍欄。已經有太多次我都走錯路了。我說，路都長的這麼像！我哪知道…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *ahem* Record 3E74- uh oh. Chipmunk glitch, dammit.
fields.target: * 啊哼 * 紀錄 3E74- 喔、噢。發生故障，該死。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Beautiful flowers and trees are really nice and refreshing. Gives a nice change from all that time before when I had to walk across barren wastelands
fields.target: 美麗的花和樹真的很棒又清爽。在我穿越啥都沒有的地方之後，這真是不錯的改變。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I used to be the ultimate master of sneak and shadows! Then I took a sweetroll in my list of addictions. Do I regret it? Mmm, nope!
fields.target: 我以前也是潛行的暗影大師！直到我對甜塔上癮…後悔？嗯 ~ 怎麼可能！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *stretching sounds*
fields.target: * 伸展的聲音 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Why must I be limited to one talent? Why not be a dual-wielder of swords, shooting arrows of death from my mouth and fireballs of doom from my eyes?
fields.target: 為什麼我一定得把一項天賦練到頂點？為什麼不雙持亂舞，用我嘴巴射出要命的箭，然後從眼睛噴出火球？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *grunt* This...thing... is HEAVY! Whoo! How the heck was he able to swing that buster before!?
fields.target: * 咕噥 * 這…玩意…好重！哇靠！見鬼了，他是怎麼把這揮動這把鬼玩意的！？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Muahaha! Fear me and my GIGANTIC BATTLE- Woaah! Eheh, note to self, don't life heavy battleaxe above your head
fields.target: 姆哈哈哈！恐懼我偉大的戰鬥技 - 嗚哇！嗷呿，警告自己，別在頭上有一把斧頭時說大話！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Huh, erm... oh well, a metal chunk of ball is better than a cooking pan! I think I can make having a mace work out.
fields.target: 啊，嗯…好吧，一顆大金屬球總好過一片餐盤！至少我想我可以拿它來做把狼牙棒。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Aaahh, just right! Now I'll feel ready to kill!
fields.target: 啊，就是這樣！現在我感覺可以去砍人了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Having both swords in both hands just feels balanced. Not to mention I can make double the cuts I could've made if I had only one sword!
fields.target: 有兩把劍在兩隻手中的感覺真好。更別提我可以一次就砍兩刀，而不是隻有一把刀時只能一劍一劍慢慢砍了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You're not gonna make me cut trees with this axe are you? Because I'll have you know... I, am and EXCELLENT lumber woman! What? Gold is gold!
fields.target: 你不會是想叫我拿這把斧頭去砍樹吧？因為你知道嗎…我，可是一個超強的伐木工！啥？錢就是錢！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Eeh, having one sword throws off my balance, but I'll try my best! Just, don't be too mad if I swing too close.
fields.target: 呃，只拿一把劍會讓我身體無法保持平衡，但我會努力的！不過，如果我不小心砍到你別介意。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know, I've always been a fan of the bow over...well, I don't think you'd be familiar with what a rifle is... but main point, I LOVE BOWS!
fields.target: 你知道嗎，我一直都是弓箭的粉絲…算了，反正我想你也不知道來福槍是什麼…但重點是，我·愛·弓！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Bowwoman Record! at your service! I'll make sure to go straight for the head!
fields.target: 神射手·璐音！在此為您服務！我會確定每箭都正中你的小腦袋的！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Okay, what is it with wooden shields? I don't want to burn up again like I did back in the death mountain let along dragonfires!
fields.target: 好，這木頭盾牌是幹啥用的？我可不想像上次在山上被龍火燒的時候一樣又被燒起來！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Probability of fighting very soon Very high. Probability of me surviving with these empty hands? Ooo... not looking good.
fields.target: 大概馬上就要幹架了。而兩手空空就上戰場的我活下來的機會有多高？喔…似乎不太妙。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 2F53 woah, woah! Damn. this. thing.
fields.target: 紀錄 2F53 哇、哇！該死，這個、破東西。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hello? Team AC222? Hey, I need a new recorder! *bzzzt* Respond! Great, now nothing seems to be working right...
fields.target: 哈囉？ AC222 小組？嘿，我需要新的紀錄器！ * bzzzt * 請回應！太好了，這下沒有一個東西是正常的…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *stretching* - Ohp! Ow, ow, ow, cramp!
fields.target: * 伸展 * - 噢！哇、哇、哇，抽筋了！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *heavy breathing* How much further do we have to run? I should've worked on my cardio...
fields.target: * 沉重呼吸 * 我們到底還要跑多遠？我得調整一下心跳…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We are currently at a great level for combat and quest files! Now, I think we should really focus on "inn hopping" and "celebration" records!
fields.target: 我們有非常優秀的戰鬥和探索紀錄！現在，我想我們該專心在「酒店狂歡」和「開趴慶祝」的紀錄上！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Apparently there's another museum here. The Mythic Dawn Museum. Okay, no museum for the champion of Cyrodil, but a museum for the enemy!? Ugh, great.
fields.target: 很顯然這邊還有另一座博物館。破曉神教博物館。非常好，沒有代表希羅帝爾英雄的博物館，但有他們敵人的博物館！？哇，太棒了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Did I remember to record that last time we went to an inn, and you got really drunk and made love to a... Oh, oh yeah I did! It's right here.
fields.target: 我有記得紀錄我們上一次去旅店，你喝個爛醉接著跑去上了… 喔、喔，對，我有紀錄！就在這裡。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: This is Record calling in... Uhm, no not yet... I know we're on it but, Alright, reporting out.
fields.target: 這是璐音的呼叫…啊，不、還不行…我知道我們還有事要做，但，好吧，回報結束。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Did that guard just...uhm, nevermind. I must be seeing things.
fields.target: 剛剛那個守衛是不是…嗯，不用介意。我一定是看錯了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I guess in Markarth, the prisoners here are given death "ore" the mine. Hehe, sorry.
fields.target: 我猜在馬卡斯裡，犯人都死於「挖」坑。嘿嘿，啊抱歉。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *heavy breathing* Is the 7,000 steps of butt and leg pain really necessary? They couldn't install, oh I don't know, a freaking dwemer lift?
fields.target: * 沉重呼吸 * 爬 7000 階讓大腿和屁股這麼痛苦，真的有必要嗎？他們難道沒辦法裝個，啊我不知道，像神經病鍛莫一樣的升降梯嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Do it! I just saw an eagle fly by, so take the leap of faith! Oh wait, there aren't any haystacks down there? Nevermind, I take it back! Don't jump!
fields.target: 跳吧！我才剛看到一隻老鷹飛過去，所以你要有信心！ㄟ等等，下面沒有舖草堆？算了，我把那句話收回來！別跳！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We better get some invaluable information out of those Greybeards after that killer climb. At the very least, nice round butts.
fields.target: 在那要人命的爬山之後，我們最好從這些灰鬍子身上知道些有用的訊息。最最最少，還我美好的小屁屁。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Magic sure is nice, beats having to put up these lights manually. Can you imagine?
fields.target: 魔法真的很不錯，手動一動就可以把光放上去。你說這是不是很帥？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You'd think with all the research on magic done here, they'd have rebuilt their own bridge by now. That thing is a safety hazard in every way!
fields.target: 你可以想像所有的魔法研究都在這裡進行，但他們真的應該把那座橋修一修。每一次經過都要冒生命危險！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Do you think the college has a spell for making recordings? Because this stupid machine's one malfunction away from me breaking it!
fields.target: 你覺得學院有製作紀錄的魔法嗎？因為這臺笨機器一故障我就想砸爛它！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Any minute now, I expect some mad researcher upstairs to be laughing "Hahaha, my theory was correct!" It's a surprise I haven't heard one yet.
fields.target: 不論何時，我都期待樓上能有個瘋狂學者哈哈大笑「哈哈哈，我的理論是正確的！」，但我很驚訝我從沒聽過。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Where exactly does magic come from in Skyrim? A mana pool? Contracts with a demon? magical blood cells?
fields.target: 天霜的魔法到底是從哪裡來的？魔法池？ 與惡魔簽約？魔法細胞？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I always thought this place would be filled with music and singing 24/7, but man, it's awfully quiet.
fields.target: 我總是幻想這地方換充滿了音樂和歌唱 24/7，但天啊，這裡真天殺的安靜。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm going to write a song! It'll be called "The Tale of Record! Who just follows around heroes on their missions" it's a work in progress, you'll see
fields.target: 我要寫一首歌！它就叫「璐音之書 - 見證英雄完成任務的人」正在編寫中，你等著看。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.target: * 哼曲聲 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ah, and here is the legendary Jorrvaskr. So, let me get this straight. It's basically an upside down boat?
fields.target: 啊，這裡就是傳說中的勇者之家。那，讓我直接來看看，這基本上是一艘翻過來的船？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Do you think with the Skyforge, we can mold an ultimate, powerful, unbreakable! recorder? Eh, it was worth a shot.
fields.target: 你認為如果用天際鍛爐，我們可以做出超越極限、強大、無法破壞的！紀錄器？ 嗯，這值得一試。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Is the Jarl not choosing any side make him more admirable or a coward? Hmm, yet to be seen.
fields.target: 領主不選邊站，會讓他更使人欽佩還是變成懦夫？嗯，遲早會知道。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know, I thought that Braith was the worst kid I've seen. Seeing Dagny, I see there are now two devil spawned children in this world.
fields.target: 你知道，我還以為布賴斯是我看過最糟糕的孩子了。但看看達格尼，我看到這世上誕生了兩個惡魔小鬼。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hm? Where's the dragon? My manual said that there was a dragon captured here... oh, that was in the first era...
fields.target: 嗯？龍在哪裡？ 我的手冊說有條龍被監禁在這裡…啊，那是在第一紀年…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And this is where it all began...
fields.target: 這裡就是開始一切之地…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record...E...5...2...9- Jeezus! I can't even remember the number anymore, it's freezing cold! *shiver* Can we please get inside soon?
fields.target: 紀錄…E…5…2…9 -  我的天！我甚至記不住編號了，真天殺的冷！ * 發抖 * 我們可以趕快找個地方躲嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *shivers* Can't. Feel. My body. Dying. *shivers*
fields.target: * 發抖 * 沒辦法 ‧ 感受 ‧ 到 ‧ 我的 ‧ 身體 ‧ 要不行啦。 * 發抖 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey dragonborn? Maybe you can call a dragon and have him breathe some fire. Yeah, fire sounds really good right about now.
fields.target: 嘿，龍裔？也許你可以叫條龍出來弄點火。對，現在能有火聽起來真的很不錯。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 3N29: Record reporting in, for this may be the final recording before I freeze my mouth off.
fields.target: 紀錄 3N29：璐音報告，因為這可能是我嘴巴還能動，還沒被凍成冰塊的前最後一次紀錄。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Good thing the recorder and all the files are waterproof! Unfortunately, I can't say the same for myself. *sighs*
fields.target: 真高興那些紀錄器和檔案全都防水！但真不幸，璐音姬沒辦法說自己也防水。* 嘆氣 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, on the bright side, it's not snowing! Yeah, definitely ten times better than snowing!
fields.target: 嗯，往好的方面來說，現在沒下雪了！耶，這肯定比下雪要好上百倍！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You think this rain will be enough to wash off that stain from earlier? Hmm... I guess blood doesn't wash that easily...
fields.target: 你覺得這場雨可以洗掉之前那些汙點嗎？嗯…我想血沒那麼容易洗掉…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm starting to see a trend of heroes who love to run and fight in the rain. Why is that?
fields.target: 我開始看到英雄們有很愛在雨中奔跑和戰鬥的傾向。為什麼要那樣？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ugh, great. My hair is soaked, my clothes are wet, and let's not even mention how wet my undies are.
fields.target: 啊，太棒了，我的頭髮全濕了。衣服也全泡湯，更不用說現在我的內衣有多濕了。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record 2E55: Dragonborn ventures on valiantly, so very heroic! Giving... no regard for his followers loudly grumbling stomach or need for sleep.
fields.target: 紀錄 2E55：龍裔勇敢冒險，非常神勇！對…他追隨者那餓的咕咕叫的肚子、和需要的睡眠時間，表示毫不關心。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Did you feel that? It feels like...Hunger. By the way, isn't it time for dinner yet?
fields.target: 你感受到了嗎？這感覺就像…肚子餓。對了，晚餐時間還沒到嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, always think positive, I say: I'm positive that we might get caught by the guards for this.
fields.target: 嗯，總是往正面看，我說：我很正面，我們應該會因此而被守衛抓。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You sure we should be here? Last time I checked, the door was locked.
fields.target: 你確定我們應該待在這裡？上次我檢查的時候，那個門是鎖著的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: As an observation, the ratio of time we spend in other people's homes than in our own home is alarmingly huge.
fields.target: 根據觀察，我們花在別人家的時間，遠遠超過待在自己家。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm sure whoever lives here doesn't mind "guests", especially ones with only "good intentions". Unfortunately, we don't qualify for either of those.
fields.target: 我很確定不管是誰住在這裡，都不介意「給人看」，尤其是給有「好心」的人看。很不幸，我們不同時具備那兩個條件。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oof! Sorry, was looking at my files.
fields.target: 喔！拍謝，剛剛在看我的檔案。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oof! Hey!
fields.target: 噢！嘿！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Uuf! Careful, I almost dropped all my files.
fields.target: 嗚！小心點，我差點掉了我的檔案。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh yeah, that. I guess I should explain.
fields.target: 喔，對，那個啊。我猜我得解釋。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I record the events that happen on the Dragonborn, your, adventures, and keep everything in these files to make sure I get the story right.
fields.target: 我記錄龍裔身上發生的每一個事件 - 也就是「你」的冒險， 然後確定我把這些故事都保存到檔案裡面。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: As for the talking, well, just think of it as me keeping mental notes. I don't think Skyrim features voice recorders, so, you wouldn't understand.
fields.target: 至於喃喃自語的時候，嗯，你就把它當作是我在心裡做筆記。我不認為天霜有錄音機，所以，你不會懂的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Why do you keep talking to yourself about "records"?
fields.target: 為什麼妳老叫自己是『璐音姬』？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Ahh, another lovely town with blackmail and backstabbing, thieving! Don't you just love Riften?
fields.target: 啊，又一座美麗的城市，伴隨著恐嚇、背刺，還有偷東西！這樣你還不愛上裂谷城嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: What do you think of Riften?
fields.target: 妳認為裂谷城怎樣？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh yeah? You think so too? Great, I'm so glad we agree! What are we still doing here then?
fields.target: 喔，是嗎？你也這麼想？很好，我很高興我們有共識！那我們還在這裡幹嘛？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: No, not really.
fields.target: 不，不是的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Huh, interesting. Record 4K15: Dragonborn has no radar for sarcasm.
fields.target: 哼，有趣。紀錄 4K15：龍裔聽不懂反諷。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Yeah! This place is just the best!
fields.target: 對！這地方是最棒的！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You know, if you actually take out all the annoying kids *coughs* Braith! *coughs*. And that annoying preacher

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I wouldn't mind living here. It's very... peaceful.
fields.target: 我不介意住在這裡，這裡非常的…和平。

fields.source: But then you realize there are those annoying people, so, I'll just keep moving on with you.

fields.target: 妳覺得白漫城怎麼樣？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: This place, is so... very...
fields.target: 這個地方，是如此…多麼的…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: COLD! And I mean it!
fields.target: 冷！ 而且我是說真的！

fields.source: Winterhold? I mean, who names their hold after a season?

fields.source: Wait, I don't know if that's a good thing or...

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: and was considered being one of the better performing students in that subject!

fields.source: Well, that and inventory control, but I always had more fun swinging weapons than learning how to carry more stuff.

fields.source: What do you mean?

fields.source: Ahhaha... well, maybe another day, dragonborn. The story's quite long and… not quite the joyous tale.

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Though I see that that the distraction turned out to have a lot more horrible consequences than I wished...

fields.source: if I had just ran the other way or stood to fight, I...
fields.target: 如果那時候我是往另外一邊跑，還是奮而挺身戰鬥，那我…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I really do just end up messing up things, like always.
fields.target: 我總是把事情給搞砸了，跟以前一模一樣。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: It wasn't your fault.
fields.target: 那不是妳的錯。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Is it? I don't know. A whole city was sent up in smoke, but you were able to escape and survive.
fields.target: 是嗎？我不知道。整座城鎮都被濃煙燃燒，但你也因此而得以逃出生天。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: If I had ran another way, maybe the soldiers, the children and their fathers would still be alive now.
fields.target: 如果當初我是跑向另外一邊，也許那些士兵、小孩和他們的父親到現在都還會活著。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: But, would that have meant you're death at an imperial beheading?
fields.target: 不過，這是不是代表著你就會死在帝國的斷頭臺上？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: To be honest, dragonborn, in the beginning I wasn't even supposed to follow you.
fields.target: 說實話，龍裔，打從一開始我就不該和你一起旅行。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: For that matter, I was never supposed to speak or interact with you
fields.target: 甚至，我也不應該跟你聊天和互動。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Simply observe from the shadows and make my recordings without you even knowing I exist.
fields.target: 我應該就躲起來偷偷抄筆記，讓你完全察覺不到我的存在。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: That was what was instructed, by my mentor, the protocols, and the academy, but...
fields.target: 這是早就規定好的，由我的導師、協定，以及學院，但是…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: After what had happened to Helgen, I couldn't just sit in my guilt and continue watching the people of Skyrim die by dragons.
fields.target: 在看到聖地鎮的慘況之後，我實在沒辦法抱著一顆愧疚的心靜靜坐在那邊，冷冷看著天霜的人們死在巨龍的利爪下。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And though I knew that you as the dragonborn could probably single handedly end this dragon menace.
fields.target: 而且既然我知道你就是龍裔，很可能就是那唯一一個能夠阻止這場巨龍災難的人。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I felt wrong in just remaining silent and having you clean up the messes left behind
fields.target: 我感覺就這樣保持沉默、靜靜看著你把這一切都解決是不對的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Whether it be mine with Helgen or any future messes left by others.
fields.target: 不管聖地鎮的災難是不是我的錯，還是未來會有別人造成別的混亂都一樣。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: That's why, Dragonborn, I decided that, even if it is against my orders from the academy, and even if I cannot be of the greatest use to you
fields.target: 這就是為什麼，龍裔，我下定了決心，即使這會違反學院給我的指令，即使我可能無法幫上你的忙。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: If there is smallest thing I can provide assistance with, I would give it my all
fields.target: 但如果我能夠在這件事上幫了你那麼一點點的小忙，我也義無反顧。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: For the people of this realm, for Skyrim, and for you, Dragonborn. I owe you all that much.
fields.target: 為了這個位面的人們、為了天霜、也為了你 - 龍裔。這是我欠你的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I have some questions for you.
fields.target: 我想問妳一些問題。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Sure, what's up?
fields.target: 當然，怎麼了？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And I have answer! Maybe...what's up?
fields.target: 而我有答案！也許啦…什麼問題？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Okay, what is it you were curious about?
fields.target: 好，是什麼讓你這麼好奇？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Hey, still need help with finding your files?
fields.target: 嘿，還需要我幫妳找檔案嗎？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Well, I'm almost a third done with drafting my will, so... yeah, I'm still pretty much toast by the academy.
fields.target: 呃，我才剛剛要寫完第三張，所以…要，我現在還是被學院檔案火燒屁股。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Fine, I'll help you out.
fields.target: 沒問題，我會幫妳找出來。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: You-you will? Oh thank you thank you! Thank you for not abandoning me! Okay, let's see...
fields.target: 你 - 你會嗎？喔，謝謝你、謝謝你！謝謝你沒有拋棄我！很好，讓我想想…
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Thankfully, I just lost the first five files of my recordings, and I kind of remember where those five recordings took place.
fields.target: 感謝老天，我只弄丟了我最早的五個紀錄檔，而且我還依稀記得是在哪搞丟那五個檔案的。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: The first one should be somewhere near when I first arrived to Skyrim, which was in Winterhold.
fields.target: 第一個肯定就掉在我第一次抵達天霜的地方，也就是冬駐城！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: I'm ready whenever you are!
fields.target: 你準備好了我們就出發！
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Better get to that will.
fields.target: 妳最好趕快把它寫完吧。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: *sniffles* So cruel dragonborn! *sniffles*
fields.target: * 啜泣 * 龍裔你好冷血！ * 啜泣 *
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Tale of Tongues
fields.target: 發聲者傳奇
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Alduin's wings, they would darken the skies. His roar fury's fire, and his scales sharpened scythes
fields.target: 奧杜因之翅，遮蓋天空。牠吼出焚天烈焰，牠鱗片如同利刃。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Men ran and they cowered, and they fought and they died. They burned and they bled, as they issued their cries
fields.target: 人們爭相逃跑、恐懼躲藏，他們戰鬥、他們死亡。他們體無完膚、他們血流如注，他們苦痛、他們哭嚎。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: "We need saviors to free us, from Alduin's rage." Heroes on the field of this new war to wage
fields.target: 『我們需要救主拯救我們，擺脫奧杜因的憤怒。』大地上的英雄們，高舉義旗掀起聖戰。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And if Alduin wins, man is gone from this world. Lost in the shadows of his black wings unfurled
fields.target: 如果奧杜因勝利，人類將不存於世。失落在牠那雙黑翼壟罩的暗影之下。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: But then came a hero on that terrible day, steadfast as winter, he enters the fray
fields.target: 但英雄在此災厄之日奮起而出，宛若嚴冬般堅定，他踏入了戰火。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And all heard the music of Alduin's doom, the sweet song of Skyrim, sky-shattering thu'um
fields.target: 所有人都聽到了奧杜因的毀滅之聲。天霜的天籟之音，連天空也為之震撼。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And so the hero saved all from Alduin's rage, gave the gift of the voice, ushered in a new age
fields.target: 英雄拯救了我們，逃離奧杜因的憤怒。以吼聲為記，新時代降臨。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: And if Alduin's eternal, then eternity's done, now the story is over, so soon I must be gone
fields.target: 如果奧杜因即是永恆，永恆已不復存在 - 故事已經結束，我也將要離去。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Oh sweet one, sleep well tonight. This world will wear you down.
fields.target: 喔，寶貝，今晚安穩入眠，這個世界會陪著你。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Take rest in this lullaby. And in my arms I'll hold you tight.
fields.target: 在歌聲中沉沉睡去。我的手臂會將你緊緊抓牢。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: When hardships never seem to die. In flames and steel, they cry.
fields.target: 當苦難似乎永不消退。在烈焰與鋼鐵中，他們哭嚎。

fields.source: Remember, this lullaby, and a brighter tomorrow you'll find.
fields.target: 請記住，這首搖籃曲，你會找到更閃亮的明天。

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Tracking the Lost Files
fields.target: 追尋失落的檔案
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: Record seems to have lost some of her files during her travels. I have agreed to help her out in finding those recordings, and hopefully, I'll also be able to find out a bit more about who she is and why she is here.
fields.target: 看起來璐音似乎在旅行途中弄丟了一些檔案。我答應要幫她找回那些失落的紀錄檔，而且老天保佑，我希望能藉此再多瞭解她一點，像是她是打哪來的，以及她為什麼會來這裡。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We've found the first file. Record mentioned the location of the second file would be somewhere south of Windhelm. She mentioned something about hot springs and geysers... perhaps near the sanctuary?
fields.target: 我們找到了第一個檔案了。璐音說第二個檔案可能就掉在風舵城南邊的某個地方。她還說到了一些有關於溫泉和噴泉的事…也許就在會所附近？
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We've found the second file. Record stated that she journeyed to Whiterun next, so the third file may most likely be somewhere in the city. We should start searching near the area close the marketplace, as Record mentioned she was carrying some "delicacies".
fields.target: 我們找到了第二個檔案。璐音說她之後就跑到白漫旅行了，所以第三個檔案可能就掉在白漫城裡頭。我們應該從市場那裡開始搜尋，因為璐音說她跑去市場買了些「好吃的」。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We've found the third file. Record recalls passing near Helgen, more specifically, a fort close to the city. I should search past the city for any forts near the area.
fields.target: 我們找到了第三個檔案。璐音想起來她也曾到過聖地鎮附近，更正確來說，是靠近城鎮附近的堡壘。我應該搜索任何靠近聖地鎮的堡壘周遭區域及通路。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We've found the fourth file. Record said the final file must be somewhere near where we first met, Riverwood. I should return to the town, perhaps where I first met Record, the Sleeping Giant Inn, to locate the final file.
fields.target: 我們找到了第四個檔案。璐音說最後一個檔案肯定就掉在我們第一次見面的地方 - 河木鎮。我應該回去那座小鎮，也許就在我和璐音第一次見面的地方 - 沉睡巨人旅店，可以找到有關於最後一個檔案的地點。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw

fields.source: We've finally found all five of Record's lost files. I should speak with Record about the contents of the recordings we collected. Hopefully, I'll learn the truth of why Record is here, who is this Narcisse person, and what is this academy.
fields.target: 我們終於把璐音弄丟的五個檔案都找回來了。我應該跟璐音談談有關於我們所蒐集的那些檔案的內容。希望，我終於可以知道璐音到底為什麼會來這裡、那個叫娜希絲的人是誰，還有學會到底是什麼。
fields.provenance: Recorder Follower Base CHT 3.0; OpenCC s2tw character normalization; OpenCC s2tw
